title: Universal Approximation Theorems for Dynamical Systems with Infinite-Time Horizon Guarantees
summary: Universal approximation theorems establish the expressive capacity of neural network architectures. For dynamical systems, existing results are limited to finite time horizons or systems with a globally stable equilibrium, leaving multistability and limit cycles unaddressed. We prove that Neural ODEs achieve $\varepsilon$-$δ$ closeness -- trajectories within error $\varepsilon$ except for initial conditions of measure $< δ$ -- over the \emph{infinite} time horizon $[0,\infty)$ for three target classes: (1) Morse-Smale systems (a structurally stable class) with hyperbolic fixed points, (2)…
